ideas.title: Keywake
ideas.mechanic: Walk stationary rooms, collect persistent keys, choose efficient key order, exit.
ideas.decision: SELECTED: finite observable projection, 47 states per seed, reversible entry alternatives, visual key and hatch goal.

ideas.title: Ember Mosaic
ideas.mechanic: Flip a tile and fixed neighbors to restore a small colored emblem.
ideas.decision: NOT SELECTED: feedback must explain indirect toggles; more fixture-like and less immediate goal readability.

ideas.title: Gear Bloom
ideas.mechanic: Turn one of two linked gear clusters to align petal marks.
ideas.decision: NOT SELECTED: arithmetic coupling and visual overlap make first-five-second understanding harder.
